notes: Bookmarks in the reader: mark as many places in a book as you like, in a PDF or an EPUB, and go back to any of them
Turning your phone keeps your place in the book, and an EPUB's highlights stay on their words
Reading on a phone on its side: the notes panel scrolls, so the list of notes is there under the note box
Notes in Full text on a phone: a note's title has the whole line again
